text:
lia: vendor reported 3 multipart objects lacking SSE-KMS headers, found by their checksum job at 04:11 UTC.
dev-bot: [alert] 5043210000: multipart-complete without x-amz-server-side-encryption (objects=3).
tina: vendor logs show UploadPart and CompleteMultipartUpload with no SSE header. presigned URLs were used.
peter: quick theory: presign service stopped signing the sse header when generating part URLs after yesterday's deploy.
alex: confirmed: presign middleware dropped the header into canonical string. parts uploaded without SSE, so final object has no KMS envelope.
lia: blast radius = 3 tenant keys. bucket is private, no public ACLs, but compliance marks this P1 because at-rest encryption absent.
tina: mitigation: re-issue corrected presigned URLs (with SSE required) and re-encrypt existing objects via S3 copy. I'll run copy now.
peter: copy command example: aws s3api copy-object --bucket redwood-snaps --key <key> --copy-source redwood-snaps/<key> --server-side-encryption aws:kms --ssekms-key-id alias/redwood-snaps-cmk
lia: add bucket policy to deny PutObject/UploadPart without s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption after vendor rollout. coordinate with vendor to avoid breaks.
alex: also check KMS grant pattern: vendor role had grants relying on RequestTag; presigned flows don't include RequestTag, so grant wouldn't help if header absent. change grant to principal+resource ARN instead.
peter: runbook items: list affected keys, attach CloudTrail IDs, re-encrypt objects, hotfix presign service, add multipart SSE acceptance test in CI, enable bucket access logging.
tina: re-encrypt 2/3 done, checksums verifying. presign hotfix rolling now (ETA 20m).
lia: logging INC-2024-1102 and notifying compliance/legal. we'll schedule a short postmortem next week.
peter: follow-up: add a CloudWatch metric for PutObject/UploadPart without SSE to detect regressions earlier.
tina: will paste vendor log snippets and presign diff to the ticket once deploy finishes. :thumbsup:
